working_definition: Author type 'lamina wide-field neuron' (L3_49, lamina_wide_field class; neuropil list names Lawf1 and Lawf2) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 larval optic lobe atlas: developing lamina wide-field (Lawf) neurons.
searches_performed: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron

best_match.fbbt_term: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron
best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will have its synapses restricted to the optic lobe in the adult.

justification: FBbt has lamina wide-field neuron (FBbt:00059323, an adult optic lobe intrinsic columnar neuron) but no immature form. At wandering L3 the cells are immature, so the immature form of the nearest parent is used: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron, as for Ozel 2021 immature Lawf1/Lawf2.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An intrinsic columnar neuron of the visual system whose cell body is located in the medulla cortex and that has a main projection making wide-field arborizations in the lamina. It expresses the transcription factor Fer2 (Ozel et al., 2021) and is cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature adult form; larval cells are immature.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific than the intrinsic neuron parent.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053540 'immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron' (broad match).
